facts.fact: OPais reports that on 30 July 2026 the Assembleia Nacional unanimously (166 votes in favour) approved the bill authorising the President to legislate the Regime Jurídico da Assinatura Electrónica e da Certificação Digital, valid for 90 days after publication; the regime itself is not yet enacted.
